app.name: SkillSync Co-Pilot
app.syntheticNote: All workers, welds and scores in this prototype are synthetic. Not for certification.

net.outbox: {n} waiting to sync | {n} waiting to sync

login.title: Sign in
login.demoHint: Tap an account to fill it in. These accounts exist only in this prototype.
login.offline: You are offline. Sign in once while online; after that the app works offline.

home.workerLead: Tell us about your work. We will match it to an NSQF qualification.
home.comingSoon: This screen is built in a later phase.

about.title: Where the AI helps — and where it doesn't
about.lead: SkillSync supports the assessor. It never replaces their judgement.

worker.consentFirst: First, please read and give consent.

consent.title: Consent
consent.cannotContinue: Consent for RPL assessment is needed to continue.

declare.title: Kaam ki Kahani
declare.lead: Tell us in your own words what work you do, with which tools, for how long. Hindi, Hinglish or English — all fine.
declare.voiceUnavailable: Voice input is not available in this browser. Please type, or tap the cards below.
declare.needInput: Say, type or tap at least one thing.

results.title: Your matching qualifications
results.noMatch: We could not recognise your trade yet. Please tell us more, or tap the cards.
results.claimsHint: Ticked skills were found in your story. Untick anything that is not right.
results.confirmed: Assessment requested. An assessor will contact you.
results.supportNote: The AI only suggests. You and the assessor decide.
results.queued: Saved on this phone — it will be sent automatically when you are online.

assessor.emptyQueue: No assessments assigned to you yet.
assessor.challengeHint: The worker writes this code on a slate and holds it in the Person photo. It proves the photo was taken in this assessment.

capture.title: Evidence capture (Process · Product · Person)

guide.process: Show the work set-up: machine, workpiece and the worker's PPE (helmet, gloves, apron).
guide.product: Photograph the finished weld close up, filling the dashed frame. Good light, no shadow.
guide.person: The worker holds the slate with the challenge code below, next to the workpiece. The code must be readable.

capture.startFirst: Start the assessment first to get the code.

qc.blur: Too blurry — hold steady and retake.
qc.dark: Too dark — move to better light.
qc.bright: Too bright / glare — avoid direct light.
qc.framing: Subject not centred — fill the dashed frame.
qc.small: Resolution too low — move closer or use the main camera.

capture.sealHint: Each photo is hashed (SHA-256), signed with this device's non-extractable key together with time, GPS and the challenge code, encrypted in the local vault, and queued. It syncs automatically when online.
capture.sealedAll: Sealed and queued — will sync automatically.

evidence.title: Signed evidence & integrity checks
evidence.reviewNote: Flags are for your review: the system never rejects evidence on its own.

scoring.title: Blind-first scoring
scoring.blindFirstExplainer: You score each PC first. Only after you lock your score does the AI second opinion appear. The server enforces this; the AI never decides.
scoring.blindNote: Your blind score is final and is kept in the audit ledger.
scoring.queued: saved on device — the AI opinion appears after sync.
scoring.reasonRequired: Big gap to the AI suggestion: please give a reason (you may also revise your final score).
scoring.keptInLedger: Your original blind score stays recorded unchanged in the audit ledger.
